rules: Workers must not edit this file. Only the orchestrator may set passes from false to true after a matching successful VerificationRecord exists, and must also record accepted_run_id, accepted_verification_sha256, accepted_at, and accepted_by. Editing or removing approved descriptions/steps is a failed task. Keep bootstrap on every feature; all Phase 1 features require real worker/process evidence and are bootstrap:false.

features.description: Every brain and worker run uses one shared provider execution path and a schema-versioned, UUID-keyed ExecutionSpec that is validated, atomically persisted before launch, immutable thereafter, and hashed by exact file bytes.
steps: Exact argv/env contract tests cover brain and worker paths for claude, codex, agent, and agy; the real brain prompt-swallow reproduction fails before the fix and passes after it
Removing a required spec field and invoking the real spawn entry point fails before the provider sentinel runs
A persisted run_id cannot be overwritten; amendments require a new run_id and receipt spec hashes use the exact persisted bytes
Unsupported requested effort or speed fails before launch, while unobservable provider values are recorded as unknown rather than guessed
No provider path uses eval, and full deterministic tests plus ShellCheck pass

features.description: Gate 0 produces a schema-versioned mission-owned frozen fleet snapshot; dispatch consumes only that snapshot, and failed live probes preserve last-good per-provider inventory while recording degraded/unknown state explicitly.
steps: A failed provider probe cannot replace its last-good binding and records the failure separately
Guessed fallback bindings are marked degraded/unknown and cannot masquerade as healthy observed models
Missing or unapproved mission fleet state rejects worker dispatch before provider launch
A live inventory change after Gate 0 cannot silently rebind an active mission
Full deterministic tests plus ShellCheck pass

features.description: Role-aware dispatch fails closed before process launch unless mission status, Gate 0, task location, feature/work-unit identity, frozen binding, provider capability, clean workspace, and exclusive workspace lock all satisfy the execution policy; cross-repository worker execution is rejected in Phase 1.
steps: Negative entry-point fixtures reject draft/unapproved/awaiting-gate/done workers, outside-mission tasks, identity mismatch, dirty workspaces, concurrent writers, unsupported capabilities, and external --repo targets
Every rejection proves the provider sentinel was never invoked
brain/mission-init and brain/gate0 remain allowed in draft; worker/implement requires in-progress plus approved fleet; brain/review allows in-progress or awaiting-gate
The workspace lock is held through receipt creation and released on every terminal outcome
Full deterministic tests plus ShellCheck pass

features.description: Each launched run produces a UUID-keyed terminal ExecutionReceipt linked to its immutable spec and capturing exact Git-visible before/after state, commits, changed paths, in-workspace scope result, timestamps, safe invocation evidence, and process outcome.
steps: No-op execution cannot inherit pre-existing dirty state or report workspace_changed:true
Changed paths outside the spec write scope fail verification; the guarantee is explicitly limited to Git-visible changes in the declared workspace
Same-second runs cannot collide and workspace_changed:null is invalid for new worker implementation runs
completed, failed, timed_out, interrupted, and launch_failed outcomes write terminal receipts; timeout/interruption terminates and reaps the provider process tree
Wrong spec hash, missing log, or malformed receipt fails through the real verification entry point
Full deterministic tests plus ShellCheck pass

features.description: Verification targets one run_id and writes a separate VerificationRecord linked to exact spec and receipt bytes; only the orchestrator may then accept that verified run by updating feature state with accepted_run_id and the verification hash.
steps: The flow is dispatch → receipt → verify --run-id → VerificationRecord → orchestrator feature acceptance; passes:true is never the verifier's starting point
Untagged, wrong-mission, wrong-work-unit, wrong-attempt/run, unrelated-success, null-evidence, and --require-workers loophole fixtures all fail
Verification records contain no orchestrator acceptance fields and a passing verification does not automatically mutate features.json
Acceptance without a matching passing verification, or with a wrong verification hash, fails
Worker attempts to edit features.json fail scope verification; accepted features record accepted_run_id, accepted_verification_sha256, accepted_at, and accepted_by
Full deterministic tests plus ShellCheck pass

features.description: One canonical harness ownership manifest drives release validation, install, update, and skill discovery; default propagation requires consistent version/release truth, managed targets, and ownership-safe writes, while an explicit development mode supports the untagged Phase 1 smoke.
steps: Restore the current README 2.3.0 versus CHANGELOG 2.3.1 baseline mismatch, then keep README, CHANGELOG, manifest, and chosen release/tag policy mechanically consistent
Determine release numbering from actual release semantics/downstream usage rather than automatically assuming a major version solely because cross-repo execution is disabled
Default untagged propagation fails; explicit --dev or --allow-untagged is required for development installation
Updater refuses a missing .harness-version and manifest completeness catches omission of guard-verification or any canonical skill
Foreign discovery entries and conflicting project-owned AGENTS.md.template survive sync/install unchanged
The harness has a real repository-specific AGENTS.md, the consumer skeleton moves to a template, completion/symlink docs are consistent, and Claude enforcement claims are accurate
All reproduced distribution regressions, full deterministic tests, JSON validation, and ShellCheck pass

features.description: A separate disposable consuming repository completes a real authenticated economy-provider smoke mission and archives enough immutable evidence for a fresh process to reconstruct authorization, execution, verification, and acceptance without chat history.
steps: Install the candidate harness only through explicit development mode, commit a clean baseline, create a tiny approved mission, and freeze one healthy real economy binding (prefer Codex/Luna when healthy)
The real worker changes and commits exactly one nonce-bearing file within a one-file write scope, then the hardened verifier checks the same run_id
The orchestrator separately accepts the passing VerificationRecord and records its run_id/hash in feature state
Archive the fleet, immutable spec, receipt, VerificationRecord, feature acceptance, commit evidence, and sanitized log into this mission's evidence folder
From a fresh shell/process, reconstruct what was authorized, what ran, what changed, what passed, and what was accepted using only archived repository evidence
No waiver substitutes for a real provider; unavailable authentication leaves the mission awaiting Gate 2
